findings.text: non-blocking: retry_failures is empty although the baseline arm's first attempt failed with 1 failed, 52 passed, 2 errors, EXIT=1 (arms-submit-1315790.log) and the focused arm's first attempt failed with 1 failed, 18 passed, EXIT=1 (focused-submit-1315802.log) before green reruns, so a reader cannot tell whether the flake is unrelated scaffolding or an instability in the modules under test.

item_verdicts.diff: read against base db9288122b commit by commit; one commit, five files, 205 insertions and 31 deletions, all inside the declared scope, with a conventional subject and a body.
item_verdicts.done_when: the measure asks the guard to pass with both rows removed, a second-process record-lock holder to move the dispatch on without launching, and the base revision to fail that same test; tests/test_every_shared_home_lock_holds_across_nodes.py:67 drops both rows, tests/test_review_dispatch_lock_holds_across_nodes.py:62 starts the holder, and the recorded base run fails at tests/test_review_dispatch_lock_holds_across_nodes.py:101 with EXIT=1.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to move the plan-review dispatch lock and the index-lag seen-set lock onto the cross-node lock, and the diff takes reckon.node_exclusive_lock.exclusive_lock at reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:2653 and reckon/crew/obligations.py:3491.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, commit 9e1fcaafeb, both suite arms in JSON with log paths, the base arm's module and cwd, the negative-control log, and the out-of-scope review-index docstring, though retry_failures is empty while two first-attempt arm runs failed before their green reruns.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the five declared repo paths and the figures-directory grant; the diff touches four declared paths plus the evidence fragment, every one inside the grant, and leaves the figures directory untouched.

justifications.durability: tests/test_review_dispatch_lock_holds_across_nodes.py:101 asserts report["dispatched"] is False against a record-lock holder, and the base run at negative-control-base-dispatch-lock.log reads that same assertion as True, so it reddens on a reversion to flock.
justifications.evidence: after-suite.log reads 57 passed EXIT=0 at 9e1fcaafeb and baseline-suite.log 55 passed EXIT=0 at db9288122b, and negative-control-base-dispatch-lock.log fails tests/test_review_dispatch_lock_holds_across_nodes.py:101 with EXIT=1 at the base revision.
justifications.fit: the dispatch keeps the lock take inside an ExitStack at reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:2650 so only a LockHeld from the take maps to the moved-on report, matching the surrounding contextmanager idiom.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:2653 and reckon/crew/obligations.py:3491 both call exclusive_lock, and both rows are gone from tests/test_every_shared_home_lock_holds_across_nodes.py:67.
justifications.reuse: both sites call the existing owner reckon/node_exclusive_lock.py:63 exclusive_lock and the diff adds no lock helper of its own.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff is inside the declared write paths listed at manifest.md:3, though the manifest lists the guard test at manifest.md:12 without the scope_note the brief asked for.
